name: WBP-Coding
description: 🌐 Production-ready Web-Based Programming (WBP) suite featuring PHP practicals, MySQL CRUD operations, textbook modules, e-commerce mini-projects, and an interactive glassmorphic showcase portal.

paragraphs: A comprehensive, production-audited curriculum repository for Web-Based Programming (WBP), featuring hands-on PHP lab practicals, textbook modules, database CRUD systems, e-commerce authentication mini-projects, and an interactive glassmorphic showcase portal.
🚀 Explore Live Showcase Portal • 📖 View Directory Catalog • ⚡ Quickstart
features: 🎨 Modern Glassmorphic UI: High-aesthetic responsive web interfaces utilizing CSS3 backdrop filters, curated HSL color schemes, and Google Fonts typography (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans).
🚀 Live GitHub Pages Portal: Zero-config static gateway providing live previews of all frontend forms, interactive calculators, and an embedded syntax-highlighted code viewer for PHP scripts.
📚 Comprehensive Academic Coverage: Full implementation of MSBTE Web-Based Programming practicals, OOP concepts, PDF generation via FPDF, IMAP email parsing, and MySQL database connectivity.
🛡️ Production Sanitized: Cleared of any hardcoded credentials, local machine paths, or private personal data, following open-source repository best practices.
